scripts.dev:prep: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply werewolf-d1-dev --local --config wrangler.dev.toml
scripts.dev: bun run dev:prep && bunx wrangler dev --local --config wrangler.dev.toml --port 8787 --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.lint:oxlint: oxlint --allow all --deny typescript/no-explicit-any apps/api/src packages/domain/src scripts apps/web/src
scripts.check:web: cd apps/web && bun run check && bun run test:run
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run check:web
scripts.build:web: cd apps/web && SVELTE_ADAPTER=cloudflare bun run build
scripts.deploy: bun run build:web && ALCHEMY_HOME=$HOME/.alchemy-werewolf ALCHEMY_PROFILE=werewolf alchemy deploy --stage prod --yes
scripts.cloudflare-login: ALCHEMY_HOME=$HOME/.alchemy-werewolf ALCHEMY_PROFILE=werewolf alchemy profile edit --profile werewolf --add Cloudflare
